name: Rime Hunger

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The rime hunger makes three Frost Touch attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Numbing Dread.

Actions.name: Frost Touch
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 23 (4d8 + 5) Cold damage.

Actions.name: Numbing Dread
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: When the rime hunger hits with Frost Touch, the chill seizes the wound's nerves — the target must make a Wisdom saving t
Actions.expresses: a killing cold that locks prey in place with terror
Actions.expressedQuote: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the rime hunger takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The rime hunger emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.
Traits.gmQuote: a frost thing whose cold makes you too frightened to run
Traits.expresses: a killing cold that locks prey in place with terror

lore: Born where the world's heat leaks out into the dark, the rime hunger is a cold that learned to want, and it comes for warmth the way fire comes for dry grass.
